content:
alex: Quick sync — planning a wedge rollout starting 11:30 PT today. Need owners for smoke, telemetry watch, and rollback readiness. Proposed ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% across cohorts (US-W, EU-W, AP-E). Any blockers?

kim: I can own smoke and initial validation. Will run the canary smoke script and validate inference sanity + correctness tests.

sanjay: I'll watch metrics (p50/p95, error rate, fallback counts). Please add me to the pager and share dashboard links.

maria: I'll be rollback owner. I prepped the rollback runbook and tested the revert for the routing policy yesterday.

alex: Thanks. High-level schedule: 11:30 start -> +10m to 1% -> +20m to 5% -> +30m to 20%. Abort criteria: error rate > 1% sustained for 2 samples, p95 > 800ms, or increased fallback >= 5%.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: 2026-03-18T11:30:00-07:00 (PT). Trigger: canary-wedge-2026-03-18. Owner: alex.

kim: Plan for smoke run: kick at +2m after start, run `./scripts/canary-smoke.sh --cohort=us-west` then `--cohort=eu-west`. Will post results here.

alex: Here's the rollout snippet I'll paste into the deploy job:

```
canary_plan:
  - t0: 0m -> 1% (10m window)
  - t1: +10m -> 5% (20m window)
  - t2: +30m -> 20% (30m window)
  abort_if:
    - error_rate > 1%
    - p95 > 800ms
    - fallback_rate_delta >= 5%
smoke_command: ./scripts/canary-smoke.sh --cohort ${COHORT}
primary_model: redwood-v2-medium
fallback_model: redwood-v1-small-quant
routing_timeout_ms: 3000
```

sanjay: Got it. I'll watch these metrics and ping if any threshold trips. Which dashboard should I use? The new canary-perf board or the legacy inference-latency?

alex: Use the canary-perf board (link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/canary-perf). If anything ambiguous, call out both.

maria: Rollback checklist is here (internal doc): https://docs.redwood.internal/rollbacks/canary-wedge. Sequence: 1) pause traffic routing -> 2) revert routing override -> 3) scale down new pool -> 4) validate baseline. I tested step 2 on staging.

kim: Quick ask — do we have cohort assignment for AP-E? I suggest starting AP-E in the 5% step only (skip 1%) due to regional capacity.

alex: Agree. Cohort mapping:
- 1%: US-W only
- 5%: US-W, EU-W, (AP-E skip)
- 20%: US-W, EU-W, AP-E

deploy-bot: Note: capacity policy allows AP-E ramp only if GPU pool utilization < 70%. Will auto-hold otherwise.

sanjay: I'll keep an eye on pool utilization. If AP-E auto-holds, we'll leave AP-E out and document the hold here.

alex: kim — can you start the smoke at +2m? If smoke passes, kick the 1% step. If smoke fails, abort and escalate to maria + infra.

kim: Yep — will kick at +2m and paste smoke logs. :thumbsup:

maria: I'm on-call for rollback. If abort happens, I'll coordinate revert steps and notify infra.

alex: Final check — anyone else needs to be in the loop? @eng-oncall?

sanjay: I'll add @eng-oncall to the incident rota for the next 60m.

alex: Perfect. I'll start the deploy and post the deploy job link here. Good luck everyone.

kim: Ready.

deploy-bot: Deploy job launched: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/12345 (canary-wedge-2026-03-18).

kim: Smoke started. Pasting short results once done.

sanjay: Watching dashboards now. p50 and p95 stable so far.

maria: Standing by for rollback if needed.

alex: Thanks team — keep updates short and post any aborts immediately. :eyes:
